templates.pattern: What is the angle between the hands at [H]:30?
At what time between [H] and [H_NEXT] o'clock are the hands together?
How many times in 24 hours are the hands of a clock in a straight line but opposite in direction?
templates.explanation: This happens once an hour, except the gap between 5 and 7 where they are opposite only at 6:00.

templates.pattern: How many times in a day are the hands of a clock at right angles?
templates.explanation: Right angles occur twice an hour, but only 22 times every 12 hours due to overlaps at 3:00 and 9:00.

templates.pattern: If a clock shows [H]:[M], what is its mirror image time?
templates.explanation: Subtract the time from 11:60 to find the mirror image.

templates.pattern: A clock gains [G] minutes every hour. If set right at 8 AM, what time will it show at 8 PM?
templates.explanation: Total 12 hours passed. Total gain = 12 * [G] minutes.

templates.pattern: What was the day of the week on 1st January, 2001?
templates.explanation: 2000 was a leap year with 0 odd days. Jan 1st 2001 is the first day of the new cycle.

templates.pattern: If [D1] [M1] [Y] was a [DAY], what day was [D2] [M1] [Y]?
templates.explanation: Difference is a multiple of 7 days, so the day remains the same.

templates.pattern: The calendar for the year 2024 will be the same for which year?
templates.explanation: Leap year calendars repeat every 28 years. 2024 + 28 = 2052.

templates.pattern: If today is [DAY], what day was it [N] days ago?
templates.explanation: 10 days ago = 3 odd days back (10 mod 7). Friday - 3 days = Tuesday.

templates.pattern: At [H]:[M], the minute hand points North. In which direction does the hour hand point?
templates.explanation: At 3:00, minute hand is at 12 (North) and hour hand is at 3 (East).
